description: An attempt at creating a 4D minecraft world mod

releases.notes:
# Changelog v0.3.2 to v0.3.3

## Features
- All land and air entities can use 4D pathfinding
- Villagers (and other entities that use their brains) can sense and remember Points of Interest (beds, workstations, etc.) across multiple slices
- Mobs will do the following goals across slices:
  - Target other mobs (e.g zombies attacking players)
  - Wander
  - Mate (e.g livestock)
  - Be tempted (e.g by a player holding wheat)
  - Follow parents
  - Pollinate flowers (bees)
  - Pick up items/food (Pandas/foxes)
  - Escape Sunlight
  - Share Anger (Zombie Piglines)
  - Place blocks (Enderman)
  - Look for bamboo (Pandas)
- Mobs, when trying to check line of sight, will do so across slices
  - This is currently done in a rudimentary way, the mob's eyes are projected into the other slices and then the raycast occurs 
  - Mobs that throw projectiles (skeletons, creepers, other stuff) will step into the player's slice before trying to use projectiles
  - Creepers will not increase fuse when out of the player slice
- Mobs are now rendered up to three slices away
- Holding shift while stepping will prevent the player from falling
- Added a new stat: W Step Count
- When holding PlaceW + (direction), an outline of the targeted block is shown
- Re-added ModMenu Config Menu

## Bug Fixes
- Stepping while sprinting or swimming no longer excessively consumes hunger
  - It now has a similar amount of consumption to sprint jumping
- Fixed an issue with distance calculation away from the origin
- Fixed crashes regarding intersections between 3D and 4D Boxes
- Fixed ability to step into solid blocks in spectator mode
- Nether portals can be created in all slices
- Fixed some bounding box intersection/containment checks

## Other
- Created a workflow for automatically creating releases

# Changelog v0.3.2 to v0.3.3alpha1

## Features
- All land and air entities can use 4D pathfinding
- Villagers (and other entities that use their brains) can sense and remember Points of Interest (beds, workstations, etc.) across multiple slices
- Mobs will do the following goals across slices:
  - Target other mobs (e.g zombies attacking players)
  - Wander
  - Mate (e.g livestock)
  - Be tempted (e.g by a player holding wheat)
  - Follow parents
  - Pollinate flowers
- Mobs, when trying to check line of sight, will do so across slices
  - This is currently done in a rudimentary way, the mob's eyes are projected into the other slices and then the raycast occurs 
- Mobs are now rendered up to three slices away
- Holding shift while stepping will prevent the player from falling
- Added a new stat: W Step Count
- When holding PlaceW + (direction), an outline of the targeted block is shown

## Bug Fixes
- Stepping while sprinting or swimming no longer excessively consumes hunger
  - It now has a similar amount of consumption to sprint jumping
- Fixed an issue with distance calculation away from the origin
- Fixed crashes regarding intersections between 3D and 4D Boxes

Minor fixes
- fixed "ConnectingBlock" blocks from crashing on movement via piston
- fixed blocks with empty outlines (e.g a coral fan attached to nothing) crashing the game when trying to push entities

minor version up

* DistancePredicateMixin now incorporates a DoubleBounds in w as well
* New advancement: "Hyperspace Bubble: Use the Nether to travel 200 slices in the Overworld"
* Fixed dedicated server crashing when opening a chest
* W facing observers now update when pushed
* demoted hyperspace bubble achievement (it's not really that hard lol)

## tl;dr
- Stepping looks nicer
- 4D biomes (WIP), farmland, and crop growth
- No more 85% bug
- new 4D screenshot tool!
## What's new since v0.2.3
- Player spawn now spread out in W
- Undersupports disabled by default
- Placing blocks rotated in W now has keybind shift+placew+direction
- Placing a block W-wards to the current block can now be done with placew+direction
- Create 4D screenshots. start with placew+f2, take another screenshot with f2, continue with f2 then end with placew+f2
- 4D pistons functional (sans blockentities) + models
- New W position indicator. configurable via Mod Menu (an optional mod)
- W-placed/facing cherry and bamboo buttons
- consistent 4D terrain
- Biomes vary across sllces
- world load shows adjacent world slice loading as well
- new icon by [BingJ](https://ko-fi.com/bingj)
- grass, farmland and crops work 4dly
- random ticks across slices
## Bug fixes
- Seamless stepping
- Fixed world loading stopping at 85%
- Chests no longer crash the game 
- Debug stick no longer causes soft server crash and functions correctly
- stairs and other blocks no long crash the game
- Client-side W chunks (fixes some client-side rendering issues)
## Behind the scenes
Releasing this as a stable release jut so it all works on curseforge. A *lot* of refactoring and weird error management was required for the update to 1.20.4 so I'm happy that's working. The 4D terrain and biomes is not perfect yet really (for example, rivers are not carved correctly) But it's nice to have some world variation over slices.
I know the 85% loading issue was very annoying so that's fixed now. The only issue for world loading could be not enough memory (a possible issue when it comes to 4DMC).
## What comes next???
- Moving up to the most recent versions. It might be possible to include 4D-ness as a Component, which would allow for an easy API for other mods adding 4D features.
- Working on bug fixes and polishing
- More work on 4D terrain

releases.notes:
### Bug Fixes
- Chests no longer crash the game 
- Debug stick no longer causes soft server crash and functions correctly
- stairs and other blocks no long crash the game
### Additions
- New W position indicator. configurable via Mod Menu
- Cloth Config now a dependency. Mod Menu is optional but recommended
### Notes
Small update adding and fixing a handful of issues brought up recently ^w^
### Links
[curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fdmc)
[github](https://github.com/inayakitori/4dmc)
[discord](https://discord.gg/jcTFJQVRRQ)

## What's new
- More functional 4D models, textures, and placements:
   - Buttons
   - Nether Wortals 1e0dfc2ec6309c78d54b489e167a15b794958150
   - Chests
   - Scaffolding
   - End rods
- 4D fluid flow: toggleable with the wFluidFlow gamerule
- 4D chests
    - Chests that place facing kata/ana
    - 2X2 quadruple chests, toggleable with the quadChests gamerule
- Enchantment tables connect 4Dly
- texture changes: as opposed to using painted over textures, we now overlay indicators more over textures. This creates resource pack independence; now repeaters and stuff won't be stuck with the "vanilla" texture if they're placed 4Dly, they'll derive from the smooth stone texture.

## Bug fixes
* mod works serverside without crashing
* fixed some crashes when placing 4D blocks that didn't have their outlines or models defined
* F3 menu now correctly shows W slices

## Behind the scenes
- we are working towards an auto model generator. Right now it runs in dev separate to the client but we hope to incorporate this into the client at startup so we can include modded buttons, doors, etc. eventually
- We made it easier to ensure blocks update 4Dly + other 4D properties, it's now an interface that we simply have to Mixin into a block to get it to work
